items.title: When the Market Moves but the Model Does Not: Stale Financial Information in LLMs
items.claim: LLMs generate persistent trading losses when forecasting beyond their training data without current price information.

items.title: The Anonymity Paradox: Identity Disclosure, Online Information Production, and Stock Price Efficiency
items.claim: Real-name policies reduce stock price informativeness by suppressing retail information production on social platforms.

items.title: Planning External-Data Adoption in Energy-Market Forecasting: A Matched Decision Framework for Global News
items.claim: Best energy forecasts use market data alone, not augmented with external news.

items.title: Forecasting, Forward Contracting, and Retailer Performance in a Regulated Electricity Market
items.claim: Better spot-price forecasts only improve electricity trading profits if retailers can flexibly adjust forward positions.
